trigger.note: No single round-level trigger pid. ST140 (NormalCollectionSpin) is the PAID base reel spin (cost=1000/spin) carrying a BuffCollection metronome (CollectCount ticks +1/paid spin 1->1000, AccCredits = 100xCollectCount, resets each cycle). The metronome is a DISPLAY counter, NOT an additive coin channel: SymbolIndexToRewards is present-but-always-empty ({} on 80,000/80,000), CreditsSymbols carries no additive win, and on every ST140 round WinCredits == sum(PayoutIdToWinAmount) (residual=0 on 100%) — the entire base win settles through the payline payid, so there is NO _unattributed_residual (NOT a live collect-coin channel; T2-supportable manifest-only). ST13 (LockReSpin, role hold_respin) and ST36 (MoveSpin, role respin) are free cost=0 reel re-spins sharing the paid spin's SpinTimes, both settling via native PayoutIdToWinAmount (residual=0). The wheel/minigame feature flow is ST136 WheelSelector (state, win=0) -> ST137 PreWheel (bare-WinCredits settlement, no payid) and ST139 ListRewardWheel (Minigame CellIndexes, bare-WinCredits settlement, no payid) — both no-payid settlements attributed by config-only SynthesizePayIdRules (m247_prewheel_settlement / m247_listrewardwheel_settlement). Per-feature WinCredits matches the server analysisResult SummaryWin EXACTLY: ST140=16,763,200 NormalCollectionSpin, ST13=18,285,300 LockReSpin, ST137=21,984,000 PreWheel, ST139=6,228,000 ListRewardWheel, ST36=2,000 MoveSpin (sum 63,262,500 == server TotalWin 63,262,500 exact, both chunks).
